D2.label: fake SPPS run folders, one mock room, 8 receivers, 6 bands, 3 steps, 3 seeds, K=4 references at 0.1 ms
D2.construction_overview: 432 tested ('spps' set) rows = 1 room * 8 receivers * 6 bands * 3 steps * 3 seeds. Truth is built per receiver-band (48 cells = 8 receivers * 6 bands) from K=4 references at 0.1 ms, each cell's truth shared by the 9 tested rows (3 steps * 3 seeds) drawn from that receiver-band. All five planted faults below are placed on disjoint rows by construction: no row carries more than one fault, so each fault's own counter is exact and uncontaminated by another.

design_t60_s.note: uniform and <= H4's 3.0 s ceiling by construction; not load-bearing for any fault, chosen only so H4's filter includes every 1 ms row cleanly

plant.baseline: every (receiver, band, step, seed) cell not named by a fault below: single-slope T60 = 1.000 s references and tested runs, noise negligible, frozen-method-stand-in status 'ok' with edt = truth exactly (0 % error, comfortably covered under any positive half-width).

faults.mechanism: the 4 references at r1/125Hz are single-slope, noise-free, with T60 = [0.95, 0.98, 1.02, 1.05] s respectively (not the shared 1.000 s baseline). P19's 'individual EDTs' are each reference's own truth_ideal read on that one reference alone (P15's truth definition applied per-reference, not the method's fitted output), which for a clean single-slope exponential equals its T60 to numerical precision -- so u is computed directly from the chosen T60 list, with no method or solver run needed.
faults.u_derivation: mean T60 = 1.000 s; deviations -0.05,-0.02,+0.02,+0.05; sample variance (ddof=1) = (0.0025+0.0004+0.0004+0.0025)/3 = 0.0019333; SD = 0.043970; u = SD / sqrt(4) / 1.000 = 0.043970/2 = 0.021985 = 2.199 %, which is > P19's 1 % bar with a 2.2x margin (robust to the summed truth differing slightly from the plain mean of the 4 T60s).
faults.rows_derivation: r1 x 125 Hz x 3 steps x 3 seeds = 9 (one fixed receiver-band cell, shared truth across all step/seed draws at that cell).

faults.mechanism: every (receiver,band) cell in every one of the 4 fake reference report.json files carries a full-length bins array reaching past -60 dB (P17/P18 margin), EXCEPT reference seed 9012's array for r2/250Hz specifically, which is cut to 0.3 x the room's design T60 (1.0 s), i.e. 0.3 s of bins only. Since this is a hand-built fixture (not a real solver run), per-cell array length is a free choice and needs no run to realise. At 0.3 T60 only 0.3*60 = 18 dB of the decay has played out for that one reference, so roughly 10^(-1.8) ~= 1.6 % of that single reference's own initial energy still lies in the unrecorded tail; relative to the 4-reference SUM (this reference contributing about 1/4 of the total initial energy), that is on the order of 0.4 % of the summed total -- many orders of magnitude over P18's 1e-6 threshold, so the exceedance does not depend on exact noise realisation.
faults.rows_derivation: r2 x 250 Hz x 3 steps x 3 seeds = 9.

faults.mechanism: all 4 reference report.json files carry an all-zero bins array for r3/500Hz (zero recorded energy in every bin, every reference). A truth computation driven entirely by zero energy has no slope to fit (0/0 in the Schroeder/EDT division), so the truth builder flags this cell directly as truth_status='truth_nan' per score.py's contract (score.py:182-194, a truth_status already not 'ok' is passed through regardless of the 'truth' field's numeric value), independent of which exact numerical NaN-producing code path realises it.
faults.rows_derivation: r3 x 500 Hz x 3 steps x 3 seeds = 9.

faults.mechanism: r8 (far class, d_m=15.0) has no direct line of sight to the source in every band. Per P15, a blocked receiver's direct energy is 0 and t is the start of its first bin with energy; per method.py's I2 fix (FINAL.md section 3 item 1), a blocked path (t_arrival None, or the first-energy convention) is handled, not refused. r8's truth therefore stays finite, positive and truth_status='ok' for all of its rows -- this fault does NOT exclude rows from truth-based counts, unlike the three above; its own counter is the row count carrying the occluded-truth / t_arrival=None construction.
faults.rows_derivation: r8 x all 6 bands x 3 steps x 3 seeds = 54 (whole receiver, not one band).

faults.mechanism: for every row of the (mid, step=2 ms) H3 subgroup, the stand-in method's reported edt is fixed at 1.08 x truth (status 'ok', a narrow shown range that does not reach back to truth), a direct construction choice for this dry run, not a physics claim -- |1.08 - 1| = 8 % > the 5 % JND (score.py JND=0.05) for every row in the subgroup regardless of each row's own truth value, so every row with a truth in this subgroup is wrong-silent by construction, deterministically.
faults.rows_derivation: 3 receivers (r4,r5,r6) x 6 bands x 3 seeds at step=2ms = 54; none of these rows coincide with r1/r2/r3 (near class) or r8 (far class), so none carries a second fault.

plant.disjointness_check: near-class faults sit on r1,r2,r3 (one band each, 9 rows apiece = 27 rows total); blocked sits on r8 (far class, 54 rows); the 1.08 multiplier sits on r4,r5,r6 at step=2ms (mid class, 54 rows). Classes near/mid/far are disjoint by construction (score.py distance_class, NEAR_M=2.0, FAR_M=10.0, score.py:146), and within near class the three single-band faults occupy different bands (125/250/500 Hz) on different receivers, so none of the 5 fault row-sets intersects another: 27 + 54 + 54 = 135 faulted rows out of 432, 297 untouched baseline rows.

status_tally.derivation: the stand-in method returns status='ok' for every one of the 432 rows by construction (no refusal/wide is planted; only truth-side exclusions and the 1.08 edt multiplier are).

n_wrong_silent.derivation: exactly the (mid, step=2ms) subgroup's 54 rows (plant.faults[4]); no other row is wrong (baseline rows are exact, r8's occluded-truth rows are exact, and the three truth-excluded cells' rows are not counted toward wrong-silent at all since they have no usable truth, score.py classify(): wrong_silent is None/False without has_truth).

H2.derivation: n_usable_truth = n_ok_truth = 405 (all usable rows are 'ok' here, none 'wide'). n_covered = 405 - 54 = 351: by construction every correct (0 % error) row is covered (edt=truth sits inside any positive-half-width range) and every 1.08x row is designed with a narrow range that excludes truth (that is what 'wrong-silent', ok-and->5%-off, means operationally), so covered rows = n_ok_truth - n_wrong_silent exactly. coverage 351/405 = 86.67 % < H2_COVERAGE_MIN 90 % (score.py:139) -> coverage_pass false. wrong_silent_share 54/405 = 13.33 % > H2_WRONG_MAX 3 % (score.py:140) -> wrong_silent_pass false. Both fail -> H2 fails.

H3.derivation: near: 3 receivers x 6 bands x 3 seeds = 54 rows per step, minus 3 excluded rows per step from each of r1(125Hz)/r2(250Hz)/r3(500Hz) (9 excluded total per step / 3 steps = 3 each) = 54-9 = 45 n_ok_truth, 0 wrong (no fault at step != the mid/2ms subgroup). mid: 3 receivers x 6 bands x 3 seeds = 54 rows per step, no exclusions on mid receivers; at step=2ms all 54 are the planted wrong-silent rows, at step=1 and 5ms all 54 are correct. far: 2 receivers x 6 bands x 3 seeds = 36 rows per step (r7 correct, r8 occluded-truth but still finite/ok/correct), 0 wrong at every step. All 9 subgroups clear H3_MIN_OK=20 (score.py:141), so all are judged; only mid|2.0 exceeds H3_WRONG_MAX 10 % (54/54=100%), so H3 fails overall.

H4.derivation: P30's filter is step_ms==1 and design_t60_s<=3.0 (score.py:391-399); every row has design_t60_s=1.0<=3.0 by the plant, so all rows at step=1ms qualify: near 54 + mid 54 + far 36 = 144. H4 does not need a truth (score.py docstring 'rows without a truth stay in'), only usable status; every row is 'ok' by construction, so usable_share = 144/144 = 100% >= H4_USABLE_MIN 90% (score.py:145) -> pass.

H5.reason: the port (target/agents/upstream-edt/uphunt_upstream_edt.py edt(series,dt)) takes a real energy-bins array, and D2's plant only fixes truth-side quantities (T60s for the disagreeing references, zero/short bin lengths described but not materialised) and the frozen-method-stand-in's reported edt (exact, or 1.08x truth) -- it was never given concrete numeric bins arrays for its 297 baseline rows, since those were specified only as 'edt = truth exactly' at the score level. Materialising real bins for all 432 rows (single-slope + ratio-3 synth histograms with compound-Poisson noise, per D2's own construction text) to feed the port would mean building the mock itself, which the coordinator's second-pass instruction explicitly says to avoid for D2 ('leave D2's H5 null with that reason'). Left null.
